en: 2 Chronicles 17

p.src: 1  Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place, and strengthened himself against Israel.

en: Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place, and strengthened himself against Israel.
u.src: 1  Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place, and strengthened himself against Israel.

p.src: 2  He placed forces in all the fortified cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.

en: He placed forces in all the fortified cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.
u.src: 2  He placed forces in all the fortified cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.

p.src: 3  The LORD was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and didn’t seek the Baals,

en: The LORD was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and didn’t seek the Baals,
u.src: 3  The LORD was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and didn’t seek the Baals,

p.src: 4  but sought the God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not in the ways of Israel.

en: but sought the God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not in the ways of Israel.
u.src: 4  but sought the God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not in the ways of Israel.

p.src: 5  Therefore the LORD established the kingdom in his hand. All Judah brought tribute to Jehoshaphat, and he had riches and honor in abundance.

en: Therefore the LORD established the kingdom in his hand. All Judah brought tribute to Jehoshaphat, and he had riches and honor in abundance.
u.src: 5  Therefore the LORD established the kingdom in his hand. All Judah brought tribute to Jehoshaphat, and he had riches and honor in abundance.

p.src: 6  His heart was lifted up in the ways of the LORD. Furthermore, he took away the high places and the Asherah poles out of Judah.

en: His heart was lifted up in the ways of the LORD. Furthermore, he took away the high places and the Asherah poles out of Judah.
u.src: 6  His heart was lifted up in the ways of the LORD. Furthermore, he took away the high places and the Asherah poles out of Judah.

p.src: 7  Also in the third year of his reign he sent his princes, even Ben Hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, and Micaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah;

en: Also in the third year of his reign he sent his princes, even Ben Hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, and Micaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah;
u.src: 7  Also in the third year of his reign he sent his princes, even Ben Hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, and Micaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah;

p.src: 8  and with them Levites, even Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tobadonijah, the Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, the priests.

en: and with them Levites, even Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tobadonijah, the Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, the priests.
u.src: 8  and with them Levites, even Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tobadonijah, the Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, the priests.

p.src: 9  They taught in Judah, having the book of the LORD’s law with them. They went about throughout all the cities of Judah and taught among the people.

en: They taught in Judah, having the book of the LORD’s law with them. They went about throughout all the cities of Judah and taught among the people.
u.src: 9  They taught in Judah, having the book of the LORD’s law with them. They went about throughout all the cities of Judah and taught among the people.

p.src: 10  The fear of the LORD fell on all the kingdoms of the lands that were around Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.

en: The fear of the LORD fell on all the kingdoms of the lands that were around Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.
u.src: 10  The fear of the LORD fell on all the kingdoms of the lands that were around Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.

p.src: 11  Some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents and silver for tribute. The Arabians also brought him flocks: seven thousand seven hundred rams and seven thousand seven hundred male goats.

en: Some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents and silver for tribute. The Arabians also brought him flocks: seven thousand seven hundred rams and seven thousand seven hundred male goats.
u.src: 11  Some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents and silver for tribute. The Arabians also brought him flocks: seven thousand seven hundred rams and seven thousand seven hundred male goats.

p.src: 12  Jehoshaphat grew great exceedingly; and he built fortresses and store cities in Judah.

en: Jehoshaphat grew great exceedingly; and he built fortresses and store cities in Judah.
u.src: 12  Jehoshaphat grew great exceedingly; and he built fortresses and store cities in Judah.

p.src: 13  He had many works in the cities of Judah; and men of war, mighty men of valor, in Jerusalem.

en: He had many works in the cities of Judah; and men of war, mighty men of valor, in Jerusalem.
u.src: 13  He had many works in the cities of Judah; and men of war, mighty men of valor, in Jerusalem.

p.src: 14  This was the numbering of them according to their fathers’ houses: From Judah, the captains of thousands: Adnah the captain, and with him three hundred thousand mighty men of valor;

en: This was the numbering of them according to their fathers’ houses: From Judah, the captains of thousands: Adnah the captain, and with him three hundred thousand mighty men of valor;
u.src: 14  This was the numbering of them according to their fathers’ houses: From Judah, the captains of thousands: Adnah the captain, and with him three hundred thousand mighty men of valor;

p.src: 15  and next to him Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred eighty thousand;

en: and next to him Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred eighty thousand;
u.src: 15  and next to him Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred eighty thousand;

p.src: 16  and next to him Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself to the LORD, and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valor.

en: and next to him Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself to the LORD, and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valor.
u.src: 16  and next to him Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself to the LORD, and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valor.

p.src: 17  From Benjamin: Eliada, a mighty man of valor, and with him two hundred thousand armed with bow and shield;

en: From Benjamin: Eliada, a mighty man of valor, and with him two hundred thousand armed with bow and shield;
u.src: 17  From Benjamin: Eliada, a mighty man of valor, and with him two hundred thousand armed with bow and shield;

p.src: 18  and next to him Jehozabad, and with him one hundred eighty thousand ready and prepared for war.

en: and next to him Jehozabad, and with him one hundred eighty thousand ready and prepared for war.
u.src: 18  and next to him Jehozabad, and with him one hundred eighty thousand ready and prepared for war.

p.src: 19  These were those who waited on the king, in addition to those whom the king put in the fortified cities throughout all Judah.

en: These were those who waited on the king, in addition to those whom the king put in the fortified cities throughout all Judah.
u.src: 19  These were those who waited on the king, in addition to those whom the king put in the fortified cities throughout all Judah.
